newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Andalucia cuts 10-year coupon to 7.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Andalucia cuts 10-year coupon to 7.25 pct.

text.p: The Spanish region of Andalucia said on Monday that it was issuing a new 10-year bond, lowering the coupon to 7.25 percent from 10.90 percent.
The bond, which matures on April 23, 2007, will be sold at a public tender on December 5 with payment on December 12.
The last auction was held on November 7, when the last tranche of the 10.90 percent 10-year bond was sold at 130.20 with a yield of 7.72 percent.
The Spanish Treasury said earlier that it was lowering the coupon on its 10-year bond to 7.35 percent from 8.80 percent.
